name: Dokazatel'stvo zhizni
source:
In 1950, a meteorite was discovered on the territory of the USSR containing an unknown metal with unique properties. After analysis, it was determined that the meteorite was from Mars. In 1956, the first expedition launched to Mars with the goal of mining this metal. Thanks to this, the USSR became the world's leading power. Gradually, small colonies grew into fully-fledged cities, and the latest technologies created comfortable living conditions on the planet, almost indistinguishable from Earth's.

But in 2006, due to a massive solar flare, Earth became completely uninhabitable within a few days. Left without support, the people on Mars were left to fend for themselves. Over time, the installations maintaining the atmosphere and magnetic field began to fail. Due to rising radiation levels, the birth rate dropped to zero, and cancer rates soared.

Five years have passed since the catastrophe. You are a young woman who once worked as a repair technician at the local telephone station. A tumor unknown to science is growing rapidly in your head, and doctors are powerless. By their estimates, you have three days to live, at most.

It is up to you to decide how these three days will unfold...

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/board/2-1-0-1938]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
1950年，在苏联境内发现了一颗陨石，其中含有一种具有独特性质的未知金属。经过分析，确定这块陨石来自火星。1956年，第一次探险队前往火星，目标是开采这种金属。得益于此，苏联成为世界头号强国。渐渐地，小型殖民地发展成为成熟的城市，最新的技术在地球上创造了舒适的生活条件，几乎与地球没有什么区别。

但在2006年，由于大规模的太阳耀斑，地球在几天之内就变得完全无法居住。火星上的人们失去了支持，只能自力更生。随着时间的推移，维持大气层和磁场的装置开始失效。由于辐射水平上升，出生率降至零，癌症发病率飙升。

距离那场灾难已经过去五年了。你是一位年轻女子，曾在当地电话站担任维修技师。一种科学未知的肿瘤正在你的大脑中迅速生长，而医生却无能为力。根据他们的估计，你最多只能活三天。

这三天将如何展开，由你决定……

[翻译自[url=https://anivisual.net/board/2-1-0-1938]Anivis[/url]]
